scope: Root focused source review; canonical shared contract exists, not proof of native/domain implementation or complete validation.

files.inspection_kind: AppAdapter trait methods and default bodies

findings: Reuse existing AppAdapter/CommandDescriptor/CommandRequest/Receipt/Surface/Job/context contracts after compatibility review; no new parallel DTO crate.

Default open returns revision0, availability is Available, inspect is Null, snapshot empty, restore/cancel/close can return success without domain behavior. Adapter conformance must prove actual supported operations.
CommandReceipt is an auditable serialized record type; this declaration does not itself sign or verify cryptographic authority.

Current native/wasm Poet Cargo manifests had no qualia-app-contract name match in bounded direct manifest search; transitive/other adapters not fully traced. Reconcile existing shared IntentBus types rather than presume direct wire compatibility.
